prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A tidy playroom with a robot, doll and animal toys beside storage boxes. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "The Toy Room". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Doll and robot, mouse and fox.
Toy and puppy beside the box.
Pig and cow, one duck, one horse.
Tiger, elephant, play some sport!
Collect the toy and put the box back.
Keep one clear and quiet track.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
